rows.title: Commodity page and Commodity details wording, selected commodities table and error order match Design Release 2.1
rows.detail: The two live-animals commodity pages keep their frame but change their words to Design Release 2.1's: the commodity page's inset text about one notification per ITAHC, the live-animals search hint (common name, code or Latin name, with no 3-character sentence), the Trade Tariff link's '(opens in a new tab)' on its own line, Commodity details' caption 'Description of the goods', and a Species column in the Selected commodities table listing the Latin names chosen under each commodity. Commodity details' error summary lists its errors by question, every species' number of animals before any number of packages, as Design Release 2.1 does. Every changed or added English string gets its Welsh counterpart, marked as a machine draft, so the Welsh pages do not fall behind.
acceptanceCriteria: The commodity page's inset text reads 'You must submit a separate notification for every single ITAHC. You must also submit a notification for goods that do not need an ITAHC.' rows.title: Live-animal commodity catalogue matches Design Release 2.1 and holds no germinal products
rows.detail: The live-animal catalogue the commodity search offers grows from five commodities to Design Release 2.1's list, with DR2.1's codes, names and species: 0102 becomes 'Cattle' with 11 species, Horse gains Donkey and Mule, Cat and Dog become 'Domestic cat' and 'Domestic dog', Ferret and Other live mammals join 01061900, Ornamental fish replaces Fish, and the poultry, livestock, rabbit, camel, ostrich, parrot, reptile and bee commodities are added. The 12 germinal-product lines the live-animals catalogue holds today come out, because the 9 October ruling gives each set its own catalogue. DR2.1's misspelt horse names and its duplicated 'Other mammal' entry are corrected rather than copied, because the species text reaches the receiving service as the scientific name. The number of packages question follows the new list. The k6 performance suite searched for 'Cow', which no longer names anything, so it searches for 'Cattle' in the same change.

rows.title: Commodity search results, selected panel and saving the choice follow Design Release 2.1
rows.detail: The server-rendered commodity page changes how it lists and holds a choice: results sorted alphabetically with the matched text in bold, a selected panel that lists each commodity with one chip per species (by Latin name) and a remove button per chip, the 'Select a commodity' error always on the search field, and 'Save and return to overview' that saves the selection as it stands without validating. When the selection leaves only 01061900 species, the unweaned animals answer no longer applies and is cleared.

rows.title: Commodity search lists results as the trader types, with JavaScript
rows.detail: With JavaScript the commodity search behaves as Design Release 2.1's: results appear as the trader types with no Search press, behind an icon search button; ticking a species keeps the search and leaves the results open for more; Escape closes the results and empties the field while the selection stays; and a polite live region announces how many results there are and how many species are chosen. The real catalogue is too large to ship with the page, so the results are fetched from the service as the trader types. Without JavaScript the page keeps today's server-side Search button, its 3-character minimum and the server-rendered panel.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, typing in the commodity search lists matching results as the trader types, with no Search press, behind an icon search button whose visually hidden text is 'Search'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-078; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-008, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-023; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-053, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-008)

Without JavaScript the page keeps the Search button, lists nothing for a query under 3 characters, and renders results and the selected panel on the server. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-008, repo-frontend-p5-080, repo-frontend-p5-082; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p5-008 to -p5-010)

rows.gate: Look at the as-you-type search with and without JavaScript, with a screen reader's announcements, before any other client-side component copies its pattern; check its script is in the built bundle on a fresh stack.
notes: Unchanged from the existing row: no requirement behind it moved. Combines the live-typing slice (req-072), the live-region slice (req-073) and the tick-and-Escape slice (req-074): one client-side component on one page, one review, and none is observable apart from the others. c-012 (ruled): the prototype's as-you-type behaviour wins, but the real constraint that the reference list is too large to ship overrides where the results come from, and the no-JavaScript path stays. rows.title: Commodity pages chain as journey steps around the main import reason
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 makes the two commodity pages steps of the journey rather than an overview task that returns to the overview. The commodity page's back link goes to origin and Save and continue goes on to the main import reason; Commodity details comes after the main import reason, its back link goes to the commodity page, and Save and continue goes on to identification, additional or arrival details, whichever applies first. The k6 performance suite's live-animals step list walks the new order in the same change, so the suite keeps running.
acceptanceCriteria: The commodity page's back link goes to the origin of the import page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-074; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-018, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-026; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-048)

After a valid choice on the commodity page, Save and continue goes to the main import reason page; opened from the overview it returns to the overview instead, and opened from check answers it returns to check answers. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-052, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-064; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-066, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-099)

rows.title: Germinal products' Commodity details orders its errors by question and completes on its required answers
rows.detail: On the germinal-products set's Commodity details, the error summary lists errors by question: every species' total gross weight error, then every species' number of packages error. The Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields V4 page makes total gross weight and temperature optional, so a blank weight or no temperature raises no error and neither holds back the overview's Commodity details task: it shows Complete once every chosen species has a valid number of packages and any weight entered is valid. These are the germinal Commodity details page's ordering and completion rules; the germinal-products area's requirements for the page's questions (req-121 to -125) share this row.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal-products notification, pressing Save and continue on Commodity details with two species each holding an invalid total gross weight and a blank number of packages lists the error summary by question: the total gross weight error for every species first, then the number of packages error for every species, each linking to its own field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-042; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023)

On a germinal-products notification, Commodity details with a blank total gross weight and no temperature chosen, and a valid number of packages for every species, shows no error and saves. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-011, confluence-6497338582-p1-024; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023)

openQuestions: c-234: is a germinal line's quantity its number of packages (V4's 'Quantity (unit/pieces)', up to 1,000) or its total gross weight in kilograms? Default, followed here: the page asks both; 'Number of packages' is the line's quantity (required, whole number, 1 to 1,000) and 'Total gross weight' is a decimal weight in kilograms, stored and not published. Completion here rests on the number of packages accordingly.

req-1789 (status question): whether a number of packages over 1,000 is refused with 'Number of packages must be 1,000 or less'. This row's completion rule counts a packages answer as valid within whatever limit that question settles; no criterion here tests the 1,000 limit.
notes: Combines the germinal error-order slice (req-1762) with the germinal task-completion slice (req-1763): both are the germinal Commodity details page's validation, one review. c-232 (ruled, V4 above the prototype): total gross weight and temperature are optional, so neither raises a blank error, enters the error order, or holds back Complete; the prototype's blank-weight and no-temperature errors are not copied. This row sits in inc-017, which the germinal-products area's requirements for the page itself (req-121 to -125: weight, packages, temperature, the table) also fill; the combiner merges the two drafts into inc-017 and keeps its backend repo, which those requirements need to store weight and temperature. req-114 (the live-animals error order) and req-126 (live-animals completion, already met) move out of inc-017: req-114 to inc-011, req-126 to the report as exists. The germinal-products set's code is its own folder under sets/germinal-products, owned by the germinal-products theme (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-059). Depends on inc-016, which starts the germinal set.

rows.title: Commodity pages return to where the trader came from: check answers, the overview or a template
rows.detail: A trader who opens the commodity pages from check answers, the overview or a template's review should come back there, not walk on through the journey. After a change from check answers, a valid Save and continue on both the commodity page and Commodity details returns to check answers, carried by the real service's change context; from the overview it returns to the overview; while editing a template from its review it returns to the template; and while creating a template a valid Save and continue on the commodity page goes to the overview.
acceptanceCriteria: After choosing Change on a commodity answer from check answers, a valid Save and continue on the commodity page and on Commodity details returns to check answers. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-103)

While editing a template from its review, a valid Save and continue on the commodity page and on Commodity details returns to the template's review. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100)
While a trader is creating a template, a valid Save and continue on the commodity page goes to the notification overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100)
notes: Unchanged from the existing row: no requirement behind it moved. Combines the change-context return (req-119) with the template-creation return (req-091): both are where the commodity pages go back to, on the same two controllers. c-021 (ruled): Commodity details returns to check answers too, carried by ?change=1. Depends on inc-015 in this area, and on the templates area's rows that let a trader create a template and edit it from its review (inc-156, inc-159): the real service has no notification templates today, so the template criteria cannot be observed until those land.
